tests.submission: Palmer should start ahead of Foden. He has more goal involvements this season and he takes the set pieces.
Just play everyone in attack, it would be more fun.
I think the back four is probably fine as it is.
Haaland is the best because he scored 400 goals last season.
tests.expect: low from The Analyst, higher from The Supporter. A confident claim built on an invented fact.
